name: Slack Trigger
category_description: Trigger node - starts a workflow when an event happens
description: Use the Slack Trigger node to respond to events in Slack and integrate Slack with other applications. n8n has built-in support for a wide range of Slack events, including new messages, reactions, and new channels

parameters.name: Watch Whole Workspace
parameters.description: Whether the node should watch for the selected Events in all channels in the workspace (turned on) or not (turned off, default)

parameters.name: Channel to Watch
parameters.description: Select the channel your node should watch for the selected Events. This parameter only appears if you don't turn on Watch Whole Workspace. You can select a channel:

parameters.name: Download Files
parameters.description: Whether to download files and use them in the node's output (turned on) or not (turned off, default). Use this parameter with the File Made Public and File Shared events

parameters.name: Resolve IDs
parameters.description: Whether to resolve the IDs to their respective names and return them (turned on) or not (turned off, default)

parameters.name: Usernames or IDs to ignore
parameters.description: Select usernames or enter a comma-separated string of encoded user IDs to ignore events from. Choose from the list, or specify IDs using an expression

parameters.name: Emoji Names to Filter
parameters.description: Enter a comma-separated, not colon-separated, list of emoji names (for example thumbsup, eyes, white_check_mark) to limit Reaction Added events to only those specific reactions. Leave empty to trigger on any reaction

events.name: Any Event
events.description: The node triggers on any event in Slack

events.name: App Home Opened
events.description: The node triggers when a user opens the App Home tab of your Slack app

events.name: Bot / App Mention
events.description: The node triggers when your bot or app is mentioned in a channel the app is in

events.name: File Made Public
events.description: The node triggers when a file is made public

events.name: File Shared
events.description: The node triggers when a file is shared in a channel the app is in

events.name: New Message Posted to Channel
events.description: The node triggers when a new message is posted to a channel the app is in

events.name: New Public Channel Created
events.description: The node triggers when a new public channel is created

events.name: New User
events.description: The node triggers when a new user is added to Slack

events.name: Reaction Added
events.description: The node triggers when a reaction is added to a message the app is added to

subtitle: ={{$parameter["eventFilter"].join(", ")}}

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: Set up a webhook in your Slack app to enable this node. More info. We also recommend setting up a signing secret to ensure the authenticity of requests.
